name: [تحديث] Al Khaleej | الخليج
desc:
⚠️ This game is currently in alpha (v0.1.0.2). Bugs and unfinished features may be present.

Welcome to Al Khaleej — a GCC-based car game featuring hajwala, drifting, racing, and more. Choose your preferred language and currency from the settings menu. Codes can be found in our community server.

حياكم الله في لعبة الخليج — لعبة مواتر من دول الخليج فيها هجولة، ودرفت، وسباقات، وأكثر! تقدرون تختارون اللغة والعملة اللي تبونها من الإعدادات. الأكواد بتحصلونها في سيرفرنا المجتمعي (دسكورد).

New addition(s):
- Infinite Desert
- Number Plate System
(New cars and map expansions may come soon)

Disclaimer:
All content in this game is original or properly licensed. Any resemblance to real vehicles is fictional or coincidental. We do not use real brand names or logos without permission. This game is not affiliated with any car manufacturer.
